CheckTitle: SFS Turbo file systems have encryption enabled
Description: Ensure that SFS Turbo file systems have encryption enabled using KMS keys.
Risk: Unencrypted SFS Turbo file systems expose data at rest to unauthorized access, potentially leading to data breaches.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to SFS Turbo.
3. Select the file system.
4. Enable encryption and select a KMS key.
5. Verify that the file system is encrypted.

Recommendation.Text: Enable encryption on SFS Turbo file systems using KMS keys.

Notes: Checks if SFS Turbo file systems have a KMS key ID (crypt_key_id) set.
